f7146225937622af.description: We are seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join our dynamic team in Karnataka. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in data engineering and a passion for working with data to drive business insights. As a Data Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and architectures that support our data-driven decision-making processes. Key Responsibilities: - Design and implement robust data pipelines to collect, process, and store large volumes of data from various sources. - Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand data requirements and deliver high-quality datasets for analysis. - Optimize data storage and retrieval processes to improve performance and efficiency. - Ensure data quality and integrity by implementing validation and monitoring processes. - Utilize tools and frameworks such as Python, SQL, Django, and Flask to develop data solutions. - Work with Linux environments to manage and deploy data applications. - Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in data engineering and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives. f7424fe3de1b0bc5.description:
Key responsibilities: 

1.Develop and maintain Python-based robotics data ingestion and processing pipelines.
2.Handle incomplete recordings, interrupted uploads, duplicate inputs, backfills, and reprocessing.
3.Build reliable workflows with retries, idempotency, cancellation, crash recovery, and reconciliation.
4.Process multimodal robotics data, including video, images, poses, joint/gripper states, and sensor timestamps.
5.Perform data synchronization and robotics calibration, including coordinate transformations, camera calibration, and pose alignment.
6.Use FFmpeg, OpenCV, and NumPy for media processing, inspection, synchronization, and quality checks.
7.Work with PostgreSQL, S3-compatible storage, Protobuf, MCAP, Arrow/Parquet while preserving data integrity and provenance.
8.Deploy and troubleshoot processing workloads using Docker and Kubernetes.
9.Implement AI-assisted processing and quality validation, including inference checks and failure analysis.
10.Maintain testing, logging, metrics, monitoring, and root-cause analysis across capture and processing systems.

f77d6ce47910f691.description: About HeadSpin n nHeadSpin provides a global device infrastructure and performance intelligence platform used by engineering and QA teams to test, monitor, and optimize mobile and web applications at scale. Our platform gives teams real-device access and deep network and performance telemetry and the engineers who build it work at the intersection of systems programming, mobile internals, and distributed infrastructure. n nRole Overview nWe're looking for a System Software Engineer with deep systems and networking expertise to work on the core infrastructure that connects HeadSpin's platform to physical iOS and Android devices. You'll own the protocols, daemons, and communication layers that make real-device automation, remote debugging, and telemetry collection possible at scale. n nWhat You'll Do n n - Design and maintain the device connectivity stack including USB and network-based device sessions using usbmuxd, remoted, and Apple's CoreDevice/RemoteXPC framework n - Build and extend low-level communication layers that interface with iOS internals (lockdownd, DTServiceHub, XPC services) n - Develop system-level daemons and services on Linux and macOS that handle device multiplexing, session management, and protocol translation n - Work with transport protocols (TCP, QUIC, HTTP/2, WebSocket, RPC) and apply them in the context of high-reliability device tunneling n - Collaborate with platform and product teams to expose device capabilities screenshots, logs, crash reports, network HAR capture reliably and at low latency n - Keep pace with Apple's evolving device communication model (e.g., the iOS 17+ shift from usbmuxd/lockdownd to remoted/RemoteXPC) and adapt the platform accordingly n n nWhat We're Looking For n n - 5+ years of systems-level software engineering experience n - Deep knowledge of network protocols: TCP/UDP, QUIC, TLS 1.3, HTTP/2, HTTP/3, WebSocket n - Proficiency in Python and Go n - Experience with POSIX systems programming: sockets, process management, multithreading n - Experience debugging with lldb, dtrace, Wireshark, or similar low-level tools n - Understanding of network stack/OSI model and devices/protocols falling under each layer - MAC/ARP, IP, ssh/scp, DNS, SSL/TLS n - Experienced in developing REST API, websockets, RPC/gRPC protocols and WebRTC n - Solid understanding of Unix system, OS internals and networking n n nNice to Have n n - Experience with libimobiledevice or similar open-source device tooling n - Knowledge of Android's adb protocol and USB debugging stack n - Background in VPN/tunneling (WireGuard, IPSec) n - Prior work on test automation infrastructure or mobile DevOps platforms n - Hands-on experience with iOS device communication protocols: usbmuxd, lockdownd, RemoteXPC, CoreDevice n n .
